item.title: Ladies: Goals decisive as Galway record third win at Armagh's expense
item.description: Goals proved decisive as Galway secured a five points win over Armagh in round four of the Lidl National Football League on Saturday evening at Duggan Park.

item.title: Laois edge Kerry to move top in Allianz HL Division 2
item.description: Cormac Byrne's point in the fourth minute of injury-time saw Laois inflict Kerry with their first defeat of the Allianz Hurling League Division 2 campaign and pick up their third win in the process.

item.title: Carlow cruise past Waterford to fourth consecutive win in Division 4
item.description: Carlow recorded their fourth consecutive win in Division 4 of the Allianz Football League by seeing off winless Waterford (1-26 to 0-15) at Netwatch Cullen Park this evening.

item.title: Camogie League round-up: Antrim secure historic win over Cork
item.description: For a quarter of a century post World War Two, Antrim and Dublin were the dominant powers in the world of camogie, sharing the championship every year between 1941 and 1968. item.title: Wexford denied by 13-man Dublin at the death as Clare earn fourth win
item.description: Chris Crummey's injury-time point rescued Dublin a 4-19 to 3-22 draw against Wexford in this evening's Allianz Hurling League Division 1B clash at Croke Park.

item.title: Derry show ruthless streak against Offaly for third league win
item.description: Derry crushed Offaly with a 2-25 to 0-8 victory at Celtic Park this evening to join Cork and Meath on six points at the top of the Allianz Football League Division 2 table.

item.title: Limerick hit 14-man Tipp for 0-36 in Thurles
item.description: Limerick saw off 14-man Tipperary in impressive fashion in Thurles this evening to record their second win in Division 1A of the Allianz Hurling League.

item.title: Late Lennon strike sees Rossies complete remarkable comeback against Tribesmen
item.description: Roscommon came from 13 points down to defeat Galway by 2-16 to 0-21 in Salthill this evening to claim their third successive win in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Brosnan goal helps Kerry inflict Dubs' third league loss
item.description: Kerry proved too strong for Dublin this evening as they picked up their second win of the Allianz Football League Division 1 campaign.
